title: Pomegranate-Rosemary Spritz
short: A jewel-red sparkling drink, zero-proof by default, with an optional bubbly upgrade.
keywords: Pomegranate-Rosemary Spritz, date night, dinner for two, fancy, playful
intro: A welcome drink sets the tone for the whole evening. This spritz is tart, herbal and beautiful, and it's zero-proof by default so everyone can enjoy it. Top it with Prosecco instead of sparkling water if your guest drinks.
why: Handing someone a beautiful drink the moment they arrive says you planned the night.

ings.h: 50 g (¼ cup)
60 ml (¼ cup)

ings.i: rosemary sprigs (2 for syrup, 1 to garnish)

ings.h: 120 ml (½ cup)
30 ml (2 tbsp)
240 ml (1 cup)
ings.i: chilled sparkling water (or Prosecco, if your guest drinks)

steps.t: Make the syrup: simmer the sugar and water until dissolved, add 2 rosemary sprigs and steep off the heat for 15 minutes. Strain and cool. It keeps for 2 weeks in the fridge.
Fill two wine glasses with ice. Add 1 tbsp syrup (more to taste), 60 ml pomegranate juice and 15 ml lime juice to each.
Top each with 120 ml sparkling water or Prosecco and stir gently once.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and a rosemary sprig. Slap the sprig between your palms first to release its aroma.

tips: Pour the sparkling top slowly down the side of the glass to keep the bubbles.
makeahead: Make the syrup up to two weeks ahead.
plating: Big-bowled wine glasses show off the color. Add a short sprig of rosemary standing upright.
wine: Serve as the welcome drink before any menu.

faq.a: Yes. Multiply everything and add the sparkling top just before pouring.
